description: Microsoft SQL Server advanced diagnostics: wait categories, latches, plan cache, blocking chains, deadlocks, Query Store top queries, index health, tempdb contention, Always On AG, backups, SQL Agent jobs, VLF count, resource governor, and failed logins.

panels.description: Deadlocks captured by the system_health Extended Events session in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS deadlocks_24h
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(target_data AS XML) AS x
  FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets st
  JOIN sys.dm_xe_sessions s ON s.address = st.event_session_address
  WHERE s.name = 'system_health' AND st.target_name = 'ring_buffer'
) t
CROSS APPLY x.nodes('//RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') AS d(e)
WHERE d.e.value('(@timestamp)[1]','datetime2') > DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETUTCDATE());

panels.description: Failed SQL Server Agent jobs in the last 24h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN h.run_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_jobs_24h
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE h.step_id = 0
  AND CAST(STR(h.run_date,8,0) + ' ' + STUFF(STUFF(REPLACE(STR(h.run_time,6,0),' ','0'),3,0,':'),6,0,':') AS DATETIME) > DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETDATE());

panels.title: Failed Agent Jobs (24h)

panels.description: Databases with no FULL backup in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_full_backups
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT database_name, MAX(backup_finish_date) AS last_full
  FROM msdb.dbo.backupset
  WHERE type = 'D'
  GROUP BY database_name
) b ON b.database_name = d.name
WHERE d.state = 0
  AND d.database_id > 4
  AND (b.last_full IS NULL OR b.last_full < DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()));

panels.title: Overdue Full Backups

panels.description: Wait stats grouped into Paul Randal's wait categories.

targets.rawSql:
WITH waits AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'LCK_M_%' THEN 'Lock'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'LATCH_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'PAGELATCH_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'PAGEIOLATCH_%' THEN 'Latch'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'IO_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'WRITE_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'ASYNC_IO_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'DISKIO_%' THEN 'IO'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'CXPACKET' OR wait_type LIKE 'CXCONSUMER' OR wait_type LIKE 'EXCHANGE' OR wait_type LIKE 'HT%' OR wait_type LIKE 'BMP%' THEN 'Parallelism'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'CMEMTHREAD' OR wait_type LIKE 'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE%' OR wait_type LIKE 'PWAIT_RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE%' OR wait_type LIKE 'MEMORY%' THEN 'Memory'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'WRITELOG' OR wait_type LIKE 'LOGBUFFER' OR wait_type LIKE 'LOGMGR%' THEN 'Tran Log IO'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'NETWORK_IO' OR wait_type LIKE 'ASYNC_NETWORK_IO' OR wait_type LIKE 'PROXY_NETWORK_IO' THEN 'Network IO'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD' OR wait_type LIKE 'THREADPOOL' THEN 'CPU / Worker'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'HADR_%' OR wait_type LIKE 'PWAIT_HADR%' OR wait_type LIKE 'REPLICA_%' THEN 'AlwaysOn'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'BACKUP%' THEN 'Backup'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'PREEMPTIVE_%' THEN 'External / Preemptive'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'CLR_%' THEN 'CLR'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'BROKER_%' THEN 'Service Broker'
      WHEN wait_type LIKE 'OLEDB' THEN 'Linked Server / OLEDB'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS category,
    wait_time_ms,
    waiting_tasks_count
  FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
  WHERE wait_type NOT IN ('CLR_AUTO_EVENT','CLR_MANUAL_EVENT','CLR_SEMAPHORE','LAZYWRITER_SLEEP','SLEEP_TASK',
    'SLEEP_SYSTEMTASK','SQLTRACE_BUFFER_FLUSH','WAITFOR','LOGMGR_QUEUE','CHECKPOINT_QUEUE','REQUEST_FOR_DEADLOCK_SEARCH',
    'XE_TIMER_EVENT','BROKER_TO_FLUSH','BROKER_TASK_STOP','CLR_MANUAL_EVENT','DISPATCHER_QUEUE_SEMAPHORE','FT_IFTS_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT',
    'XE_DISPATCHER_WAIT','XE_DISPATCHER_JOIN','SQLTRACE_INCREMENTAL_FLUSH_SLEEP','ONDEMAND_TASK_QUEUE',
    'BROKER_EVENTHANDLER','SLEEP_BPOOL_FLUSH','SLEEP_DBSTARTUP','DIRTY_PAGE_POLL','HADR_FILESTREAM_IOMGR_IOCOMPLETION',
    'DBMIRROR_DBM_EVENT','DBMIRRORING_CMD','DBMIRROR_DBM_MUTEX','DBMIRROR_EVENTS_QUEUE','DBMIRROR_SEND','DBMIRROR_WORKER_QUEUE',
    'KSOURCE_WAKEUP','SP_SERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_SLEEP','PARALLEL_REDO_DRAIN_WORKER','PARALLEL_REDO_LOG_CAPTURE','PARALLEL_REDO_TRAN_LIST',
    'QDS_PERSIST_TASK_MAIN_LOOP_SLEEP','QDS_ASYNC_QUEUE','QDS_CLEANUP_STALE_QUERIES_TASK_MAIN_LOOP_SLEEP','QDS_SHUTDOWN_QUEUE',
    'PWAIT_DIRECTLOGCONSUMER_GETNEXT','SERVER_IDLE_CHECK')
  AND waiting_tasks_count > 0
)
SELECT
  category,
  CAST(SUM(wait_time_ms) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wait_time_sec,
  SUM(waiting_tasks_count) AS waiting_tasks,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(wait_time_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(wait_time_ms)) OVER (), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS pct_of_total
FROM waits
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY SUM(wait_time_ms) DESC;

panels.title: Waits by Category (cumulative)

panels.description: Latch waits (PAGELATCH = in-memory contention; PAGEIOLATCH = disk wait).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 25
  latch_class,
  CAST(wait_time_ms / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wait_time_sec,
  waiting_requests_count,
  CAST(wait_time_ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(waiting_requests_count,0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_wait_ms,
  max_wait_time_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_latch_stats
WHERE waiting_requests_count > 0
  AND latch_class NOT IN ('BUFFER')
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;

panels.title: Top Latch Classes

panels.description: Spinlock contention. High collisions on a single spinlock = scaling bottleneck.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 25
  name,
  collisions,
  spins,
  spins_per_collision,
  sleep_time,
  backoffs
FROM sys.dm_os_spinlock_stats
WHERE spins > 0
ORDER BY spins DESC;

panels.title: Spinlock Contention

panels.description: Plan cache breakdown by object type. Adhoc + single-use = parameterization opportunity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  objtype AS object_type,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS plan_count,
  CAST(SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS BIGINT)) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS size_mb,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usecounts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_use_plans,
  SUM(usecounts) AS total_use_count
FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans
GROUP BY objtype
ORDER BY size_mb DESC;

panels.title: Plan Cache by Object Type

panels.description: Top compiled plans by total CPU.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 25
  cp.objtype,
  cp.usecounts,
  CAST(cp.size_in_bytes / 1024.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS size_mb,
  CAST(SUM(qs.total_worker_time) / 1000000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_cpu_sec
FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans cp
JOIN sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs ON cp.plan_handle = qs.plan_handle
GROUP BY cp.plan_handle, cp.objtype, cp.usecounts, cp.size_in_bytes
ORDER BY total_cpu_sec DESC;

panels.title: Top Plans by CPU

panels.description: Active blocking chain. blocking_session_id = head blocker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.session_id,
  r.blocking_session_id,
  r.wait_type,
  r.wait_time AS wait_time_ms,
  r.wait_resource,
  DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS database_name,
  r.command,
  r.status,
  s.login_name,
  s.host_name,
  s.program_name,
  SUBSTRING(t.text,
    (r.statement_start_offset/2)+1,
    ((CASE r.statement_end_offset
        WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(t.text)
        ELSE r.statement_end_offset END - r.statement_start_offset)/2)+1) AS sql_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0
   OR r.session_id IN (SELECT blocking_session_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0)
ORDER BY r.wait_time DESC;

panels.title: Active Blocking Chain

panels.description: Lock counts by resource type and database.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
  resource_type,
  request_mode,
  request_status,
  DB_NAME(resource_database_id) AS database_name,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS lock_count
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks
GROUP BY resource_type, request_mode, request_status, resource_database_id
ORDER BY lock_count DESC;

panels.description: Recent deadlock events (last 24h) extracted from system_health.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT CAST(target_data AS XML) AS x
  FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets st
  JOIN sys.dm_xe_sessions s ON s.address = st.event_session_address
  WHERE s.name = 'system_health' AND st.target_name = 'ring_buffer'
)
SELECT TOP 25
  d.e.value('(@timestamp)[1]','datetime2') AS event_time,
  CAST(d.e.query('.') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS xml_report
FROM src
CROSS APPLY x.nodes('//RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') AS d(e)
WHERE d.e.value('(@timestamp)[1]','datetime2') > DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETUTCDATE())
ORDER BY event_time DESC;

panels.title: Recent Deadlocks (24h)

panels.description: Top queries by CPU from Query Store (run against a database with QS enabled — use the database picker below).

targets.rawSql:
USE [$database];
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_query_store_options WHERE actual_state <> 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT TOP $top_n
    q.query_id,
    qt.query_sql_text AS query_text,
    SUM(rs.count_executions) AS executions,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_cpu_time * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_cpu_ms,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_duration * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_duration_ms,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_logical_io_reads * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_logical_reads,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_query_max_used_memory * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_memory_pages
  FROM sys.query_store_query q
  JOIN sys.query_store_query_text qt ON qt.query_text_id = q.query_text_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_plan p ON p.query_id = q.query_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats rs ON rs.plan_id = p.plan_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval rsi ON rsi.runtime_stats_interval_id = rs.runtime_stats_interval_id
  WHERE rsi.start_time >= $__timeFrom() AND rsi.end_time <= $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY q.query_id, qt.query_sql_text
  ORDER BY avg_cpu_ms DESC;
END
ELSE
  SELECT 'Query Store is disabled for this database. Enable with: ALTER DATABASE [$database] SET QUERY_STORE = ON;' AS message;

panels.title: Query Store — Top by CPU

panels.description: Top queries by duration from Query Store.

targets.rawSql:
USE [$database];
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_query_store_options WHERE actual_state <> 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT TOP $top_n
    q.query_id,
    qt.query_sql_text AS query_text,
    SUM(rs.count_executions) AS executions,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_duration * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_duration_ms,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_cpu_time * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_cpu_ms,
    CAST(SUM(rs.avg_logical_io_reads * rs.count_executions) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.count_executions),0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_logical_reads
  FROM sys.query_store_query q
  JOIN sys.query_store_query_text qt ON qt.query_text_id = q.query_text_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_plan p ON p.query_id = q.query_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats rs ON rs.plan_id = p.plan_id
  JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval rsi ON rsi.runtime_stats_interval_id = rs.runtime_stats_interval_id
  WHERE rsi.start_time >= $__timeFrom() AND rsi.end_time <= $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY q.query_id, qt.query_sql_text
  ORDER BY avg_duration_ms DESC;
END
ELSE
  SELECT 'Query Store is disabled for this database.' AS message;

panels.title: Query Store — Top by Duration

panels.description: Top fragmented indexes (>10% fragmentation, >1000 pages) for the selected database.

targets.rawSql:
USE [$database];
SELECT TOP $top_n
  OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(ips.object_id) AS schema_name,
  OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name,
  i.name AS index_name,
  ips.index_type_desc,
  CAST(ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS frag_pct,
  ips.page_count,
  CAST(ips.page_count * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS size_mb
FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED') ips
JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id
WHERE ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent > 10
  AND ips.page_count > 1000
ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC;

panels.title: Index Fragmentation

panels.description: Indexes with no seeks/scans/lookups since last restart but with writes — candidates for removal.

targets.rawSql:
USE [$database];
SELECT TOP $top_n
  OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id) AS schema_name,
  OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name,
  i.name AS index_name,
  i.type_desc,
  ISNULL(s.user_seeks, 0) AS user_seeks,
  ISNULL(s.user_scans, 0) AS user_scans,
  ISNULL(s.user_lookups, 0) AS user_lookups,
  ISNULL(s.user_updates, 0) AS user_updates
FROM sys.indexes i
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats s
  ON s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.index_id = i.index_id AND s.database_id = DB_ID()
WHERE i.type_desc IN ('NONCLUSTERED','CLUSTERED')
  AND OBJECTPROPERTY(i.object_id, 'IsUserTable') = 1
  AND i.is_primary_key = 0
  AND i.is_unique_constraint = 0
  AND ISNULL(s.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(s.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(s.user_lookups, 0) = 0
  AND ISNULL(s.user_updates, 0) > 0
ORDER BY user_updates DESC;

panels.title: Unused Indexes (write-only)

panels.description: Tables with statistics older than 7 days. Stale stats lead to bad query plans.

targets.rawSql:
USE [$database];
SELECT TOP $top_n
  OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(s.object_id) AS schema_name,
  OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS table_name,
  s.name AS stat_name,
  sp.last_updated,
  sp.rows,
  sp.rows_sampled,
  sp.modification_counter,
  CAST(100.0 * sp.modification_counter / NULLIF(sp.rows, 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS modified_pct
FROM sys.stats s
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(s.object_id, s.stats_id) sp
WHERE OBJECTPROPERTY(s.object_id, 'IsUserTable') = 1
  AND (sp.last_updated IS NULL OR sp.last_updated < DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETUTCDATE()))
ORDER BY sp.last_updated ASC;

panels.title: Stale Statistics (>7 days)

panels.description: Tempdb space allocation by source. Version store growth = long-running RCSI/SI snapshot transactions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  GETUTCDATE() AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN allocation_unit_type_desc = 'IN_ROW_DATA' THEN extent_size_in_pages ELSE 0 END) * 8.0 / 1024 AS [User Objects MB],
  SUM(CASE WHEN allocation_unit_type_desc = 'LOB_DATA' THEN extent_size_in_pages ELSE 0 END) * 8.0 / 1024 AS [LOB MB]
FROM tempdb.sys.dm_db_file_space_usage;

SELECT
  GETUTCDATE() AS time,
  SUM(version_store_reserved_page_count) * 8.0 / 1024 AS [Version Store MB],
  SUM(internal_object_reserved_page_count) * 8.0 / 1024 AS [Internal Objects MB],
  SUM(user_object_reserved_page_count) * 8.0 / 1024 AS [User Objects (alloc) MB]
FROM tempdb.sys.dm_db_file_space_usage;

panels.title: Tempdb Space Usage

panels.description: Tempdb-using sessions (highest allocator first).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 25
  ssu.session_id,
  CAST(SUM(ssu.user_objects_alloc_page_count + ssu.internal_objects_alloc_page_count) * 8.0 / 1024 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS alloc_mb,
  s.login_name,
  s.host_name,
  s.program_name,
  s.status
FROM sys.dm_db_session_space_usage ssu
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = ssu.session_id
WHERE ssu.database_id = 2
GROUP BY ssu.session_id, s.login_name, s.host_name, s.program_name, s.status
HAVING SUM(ssu.user_objects_alloc_page_count + ssu.internal_objects_alloc_page_count) > 0
ORDER BY alloc_mb DESC;

panels.title: Top Tempdb Sessions

panels.description: Always On Availability Group replicas with sync state and queues. Empty if AG is not configured.

targets.rawSql:
IF SERVERPROPERTY('IsHadrEnabled') = 1
BEGIN
  SELECT
    ag.name AS ag_name,
    ar.replica_server_name,
    DB_NAME(drs.database_id) AS database_name,
    drs.synchronization_state_desc,
    drs.synchronization_health_desc,
    drs.is_primary_replica,
    drs.log_send_queue_size AS log_send_queue_kb,
    drs.log_send_rate AS log_send_rate_kbps,
    drs.redo_queue_size AS redo_queue_kb,
    drs.redo_rate AS redo_rate_kbps,
    drs.last_hardened_time,
    drs.last_redone_time
  FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
  JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON ar.replica_id = drs.replica_id
  JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON ag.group_id = ar.group_id
  ORDER BY ag_name, replica_server_name, database_name;
END
ELSE
  SELECT 'Always On HADR is not enabled on this instance.' AS message;

panels.title: Availability Group Replica State

panels.description: Last full / differential / log backup per database. Highlight: missing or stale backups.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  d.name AS database_name,
  d.recovery_model_desc,
  d.state_desc,
  bf.last_full,
  bd.last_diff,
  bl.last_log,
  CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, bf.last_full, GETDATE()) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS hours_since_last_full,
  CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, bd.last_diff, GETDATE()) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS hours_since_last_diff,
  CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, bl.last_log, GETDATE()) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS hours_since_last_log
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT database_name, MAX(backup_finish_date) AS last_full FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'D' GROUP BY database_name) bf ON bf.database_name = d.name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT database_name, MAX(backup_finish_date) AS last_diff FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'I' GROUP BY database_name) bd ON bd.database_name = d.name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT database_name, MAX(backup_finish_date) AS last_log FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'L' GROUP BY database_name) bl ON bl.database_name = d.name
WHERE d.database_id > 4 AND d.state = 0
ORDER BY hours_since_last_full DESC;

panels.title: Backup Status

panels.description: Most recent run of every enabled SQL Server Agent job.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT job_id, MAX(run_datetime_int) AS rd
  FROM (
    SELECT job_id, instance_id,
      CONVERT(BIGINT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), run_date) + RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), run_time), 6)) AS run_datetime_int
    FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory
    WHERE step_id = 0
  ) x
  GROUP BY job_id
)
SELECT
  j.name AS job_name,
  j.enabled AS enabled,
  CONVERT(DATETIME, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(14), latest.rd), 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':'),120) AS run_datetime,
  CASE h.run_status
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Failed'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Succeeded'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Retry'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Cancelled'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'In Progress'
  END AS run_status_desc,
  (h.run_duration / 10000) * 3600 + ((h.run_duration / 100) % 100) * 60 + (h.run_duration % 100) AS duration_sec,
  h.message
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
LEFT JOIN latest ON latest.job_id = j.job_id
LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h ON h.job_id = j.job_id
  AND CONVERT(BIGINT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), h.run_date) + RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), h.run_time), 6)) = latest.rd
  AND h.step_id = 0
ORDER BY run_datetime DESC;

panels.title: SQL Agent — Last Run per Job

panels.description: Virtual Log File count per database. >1000 indicates fragmented transaction log.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DB_NAME(database_id) AS database_name,
  COUNT(*) AS vlf_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_vlfs,
  CAST(SUM(vlf_size_mb) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS log_size_mb
FROM sys.dm_db_log_info(NULL)
GROUP BY database_id
ORDER BY vlf_count DESC;

panels.title: VLF Count by Database

panels.description: Resource Governor workload group request and CPU stats. Empty if Resource Governor disabled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  rp.name AS resource_pool,
  wg.name AS workload_group,
  wg.active_request_count,
  wg.queued_request_count,
  wg.total_request_count,
  wg.total_cpu_usage_ms,
  wg.total_lock_wait_count,
  wg.total_lock_wait_time_ms
FROM sys.dm_resource_governor_workload_groups wg
JOIN sys.dm_resource_governor_resource_pools rp ON rp.pool_id = wg.pool_id
ORDER BY wg.active_request_count DESC;

panels.title: Resource Governor Workload Groups

panels.description: Failed login attempts captured in the default trace (last 24h).

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @path NVARCHAR(260);
SELECT @path = REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(path), CHARINDEX('\', REVERSE(path)), 260)) + N'log.trc'
FROM sys.traces WHERE is_default = 1;
IF @path IS NULL
  SELECT 'Default trace is disabled.' AS message;
ELSE
  SELECT TOP 200
    StartTime,
    LoginName,
    HostName,
    ApplicationName,
    NTUserName,
    ClientProcessID,
    ServerName,
    DatabaseName,
    TextData
  FROM ::fn_trace_gettable(@path, DEFAULT)
  WHERE EventClass = 20
    AND StartTime > DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETDATE())
  ORDER BY StartTime DESC;

title: MSSQL — Advanced Diagnostics
